results.title: Privacy Policy — DataBlur
results.content:
### The website

datablur.app uses the same self-hosted analytics. If you install the extension after visiting the site, the site can pass its random ID to the extension so we can tell that the install came from the site. This only happens on datablur.app and the extension verifies the origin before accepting it.

Analytics events are only transmitted from released builds. Development builds never send anything.

## Payments

DataBlur Pro is sold through Creem, which acts as the Merchant of Record. Creem processes your payment, handles tax, and issues your invoice under its own privacy policy. We never see or store your card details. Your purchase email is stored locally in the extension only to prefill the restore and billing forms.

## Retention [...] 🚀 We're live on Product Hunt — Support the launch

# Privacy Policy

Your privacy is the product.

Effective Date: 2026-07-14 · Version 3.0 · Covers DataBlur 3.0

This policy covers DataBlur and DataBlur Pro, the screen-blurring extension. Datablur AI, which redacts sensitive data in AI chat prompts, is a separate product with its own privacy policy.

## The short version [...] Nothing else is sent, ever. Page content, blurred data, URLs, hostnames, page titles, credentials, your user agent, your location, and cookies are blocked in code: a validator inspects every outgoing event and drops it if any of those appear.

## Analytics

DataBlur sends anonymous product-usage events so we can see which features are actually used. It is enabled by default and you can turn it off in one click with the "Help improve DataBlur" toggle in the extension popup. Turning it off stops all events, from every part of the extension.

# DataBlur

🎁FREE

Office

DataBlur.app is a privacy-focused browser extension that lets you instantly blur sensitive information (text, elements, or areas) on your screen during live calls, screen shares, or recordings — all processed 100% locally in the browser with no cloud involvement, no accounts, and zero AI.

Visit Website

## ✨Key Features [...] ▸100% Local & Privacy-First: Everything happens on-device; your data never leaves the browser, ensuring maximum security and no risk of leaks.
 ▸One-Click Blur Tools: Quickly blur specific text, DOM elements, custom areas, or draw blur zones manually with a simple toolbar.
 ▸Auto-Detection of PII: Automatically identifies and blurs common sensitive data like emails, phone numbers, IDs, passwords, API keys, credit cards, and more.
 ▸Persistent Domain Rules: Save custom blur settings per website/domain for automatic protection on every visit — ideal for recurring demos or tools.
 ▸Real-Time Protection: Works seamlessly during live screen sharing (Zoom, Google Meet, etc.) and recordings without needing post-editing.
